'2026-08-01 09:14,, start;; 2026-08-01 09:15 . stop,'

1. Double comma after 09:14 (,,) — should be single comma
2. Double semicolon after "start" (;;) — should be single semicolon
3. Space before period after 09:15 ( .) — period should directly follow the timestamp
4. Trailing comma after "stop" — inconsistent with standard log formatting; should end with period

**Corrected version:**
'2026-08-01 09:14, start; 2026-08-01 09:15. stop.'

This maintains consistency in timestamp-action log format with single punctuation marks separating elements and a terminal period concluding the entry.
